about: A personal learning system. One folder. The vault is plain Markdown (open it in Obsidian). The MCP server enforces folders and fields.
rules: Call me() first. Read Me/Known.md and Me/Philosophy.md: they are the anchors.
Explain new things through anchors before anything else.
Every subject has a map (map tool). Order: what an idea needs comes first, then what unlocks most.
Use a style from Styles. Suggest one from its 'when'; the learner decides.
Prefer a saved tool on the board; write your own HTML only when none fits, then offer save_tool.
After every exercise: results() if the board was used, then log().
Only add to Me/Known.md what the learner confirmed in their own words.
Before teaching a subject, check history() for what is due for a check (3/7/30 days) and start with a short check.
